data.description:
## Story

As a sprint orchestrator, DEFER rulings from the arbiter create orphan-task tickets for future tracking, and DROP rulings write `defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter` records to the defense store, so that all arbiter outcomes are durably persisted and visible in the ticket system.

## Done Definitions

- [ ] When arbiter emits a `DEFER` ruling, orchestrator creates an orphan-task ticket with: title "Deferred review finding: <finding summary>", parent=epic, tag=`orphan:deferred_review`, status=pending; ticket ID logged to cycle ledger entry
- [ ] When arbiter emits a `DROP` ruling, orchestrator writes a defense record with `defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter` via `review-defense-store.sh` (locally) and `review-github-defense-store.sh` (CI); record shape conforms to `contracts/review-defenses.md` updated in S6
- [ ] Defense store readers are forward-compatible: a reader that doesn't know `dropped_by_arbiter` must ignore the record gracefully (not crash); this is verified by a test that feeds an unknown `defense_type` to the reader
- [ ] `validate-issues.sh` updated with an `origin:arbiter` exemption: orphan-task tickets tagged `orphan:deferred_review` are excluded from health warnings about unlinked orphan tickets
- [ ] End-to-end test: simulate DEFER ruling → orphan ticket created with correct tags; simulate DROP ruling → defense record written with correct `defense_type`

## Considerations

- [Ordering] Must run after S3 (arbiter schema, which defines DEFER/DROP) AND S6 (contracts doc, which pins the defense record schema)
- [validate-issues.sh exemption] Grep for the health check that flags orphan tickets; ensure the exemption is scoped to `orphan:deferred_review` tag only — do not blanket-exempt all orphan tickets
- [Defense store idempotency] If a DROP ruling is re-processed (e.g., CI retry), the defense store write must be idempotent — check whether `review-defense-store.sh` already handles this; if not, add a content-hash dedup check
- [Escalation policy] Escalate when blocked
data.title: As a sprint orchestrator, DEFER rulings create orphan-task tickets and defense store records use defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter for DROP rulings
